description: Use this when the user wants an expense added on a schedule, such as monthly rent. It is posted on startsOn and then every interval weeks, months or years; a startsOn in the past begins at the next date from today.

RecurringSplit.description:
Who shares each occurrence. `amountCents` is the share for `amount`
splits, `percentage` for `percentage`, `shares` for `shares`; an
`equal` split takes only the tokens.

amountCents.description: For an `amount` split, this member's share in minor units.

participantToken.description: A member who shares each expense, by token from `showGroup`.

percentage.description: For a `percentage` split, this member's percentage.

shares.description: For a `shares` split, this member's number of shares.

SplitType.description:
How a transaction's amount is divided across participants.
  • `equal` — equal shares across all listed participants.
  • `percentage` — percentage shares (sum to 100, server normalizes
    rounding cents).
  • `shares` — weighted shares (e.g. 1, 2, 1 → 25/50/25 split).
  • `amount` — exact per-participant amounts supplied by the client.

Token.description:
Resource token: 24 base58 characters (the alphabet leaves out the
look-alikes `0`, `O`, `I` and `l`). A token never changes. The server
generates one when a create sends none; a client may choose its own for a
transaction, participant, category or recurring expense, so a write queued
offline already knows the token it will have.

amountCents.description: Each expense's total in minor units of `currency` (¥1,000 is 1000, $12.50 is 1250).

categoryToken.description: The group category to file each expense under, by token from `showGroup`. Omit for none.

currency.description: The currency each expense is paid in.

description.description: What each expense is for, such as Rent.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID you make up for this call. If the call fails or gets no answer and you try again, send the same UUID so nothing is added twice. Use a new one for each new thing you add.

interval.description: How many `cadence` units apart the expenses are, such as 2 with `weekly` for every other week.

paidByParticipantToken.description: The member who pays each time, by token from `showGroup`.

splitType.description: How each total is divided, and so which value every split carries.

startsOn.description:
The first date, `YYYY-MM-DD`, from which the schedule counts. The first
expense is posted on the first scheduled date from today on.
